title: X Says Australia’s Under-16 Social Media Ban Risks Interfering With Foreign Law
summary: The social media platform, which sits within Elon Musk’s SpaceX , issued a submission to the Australian parliament published Tuesday that called for the government to drop efforts to strengthen its underage social media ban .
